label: Vascular access
الوصول الوعائي
description: A dual-lumen vascular catheter provides blood withdrawal (access) and return to the patient. Access and return lines are often identified by colour, but connectors and configuration differ between machines; trace and verify the actual tubing and labels rather than relying on red/blue alone.

توفّر القسطرة الوعائية مزدوجة التجويف مساراً لسحب الدم من المريض (الوصول) وآخر لإعادته. غالباً ما تُميّز الخطوط بالألوان، لكن التوصيلات والترتيب يختلفان بين الأجهزة؛ تتبّع الأنابيب والملصقات الفعلية ولا تعتمد على الأحمر والأزرق وحدهما.

label: Blood pump
مضخة الدم
description: A roller pump draws blood from the access lumen at a set rate (mL/min) and drives it through the circuit. Pump speed is a prescribed, machine-set parameter - not something a nurse adjusts independently of the prescription and local protocol.
مضخة دوارة تسحب الدم من تجويف الوصول بمعدل محدد (مل/دقيقة) وتدفعه عبر الدائرة. سرعة المضخة معلمة موصوفة يحددها الجهاز - وليست شيئاً تعدّله الممرضة بمعزل عن الوصفة والبروتوكول المحلي.

label: Hemofilter
الفلتر الدموي
description: The hemofilter has a semipermeable membrane for fluid and solute exchange. Transmembrane pressure (TMP) estimates the pressure difference across the membrane between blood and effluent fluid. Filter pressure drop (ΔP) measures resistance along the blood path through the filter. They are distinct measurements; their trends can suggest clogging or clotting but do not establish a diagnosis on their own.

يحتوي المرشح الدموي على غشاء شبه منفذ لتبادل السوائل والمذابات. يمثّل ضغط الغشاء (TMP) فرق الضغط عبر الغشاء بين جانب الدم وجانب سائل الطرح. أما فرق ضغط المرشح (ΔP) فيعكس المقاومة على امتداد مسار الدم داخل المرشح. وهما قياسان مختلفان، وقد تشير اتجاهاتهما إلى انسداد مسام الغشاء أو التخثر، لكنها لا تثبت التشخيص وحدها.

label: Dialysate
سائل الديلزة
description: A balanced electrolyte solution run counter-current to blood flow around the filter membrane, used in dialysis-based CRRT modes (CVVHD/CVVHDF) to clear solutes by diffusion. Bag changes and connections are checked for correct fluid, correct line, and air-free connection.

محلول إلكتروليت متوازن يُمرَّر بعكس اتجاه تدفق الدم حول غشاء الفلتر، يُستخدم في أنماط العلاج بالديلزة (CVVHD/CVVHDF) لتصفية المذابات بالانتشار. يتم التحقق عند تغيير الأكياس من صحة السائل والخط والتوصيل الخالي من الهواء.

label: Replacement fluid
سائل الاستبدال
description: A balanced electrolyte solution infused pre-filter or post-filter to replace fluid removed by convection in hemofiltration-based modes (CVVH/CVVHDF). Pre- vs post-filter delivery affects filter clotting risk and clearance, and is a prescribed setting.
محلول إلكتروليت متوازن يُحقن قبل الفلتر أو بعده لتعويض السائل المُزال بالحمل في أنماط الترشيح الدموي (CVVH/CVVHDF). يؤثر التوصيل قبل أو بعد الفلتر على خطر تخثر الفلتر والتصفية، وهو إعداد موصوف.

label: Effluent / drain
الراشح / التصريف
description: The combined spent dialysate, filtered fluid and ultrafiltrate removed from the patient, collected in the effluent bag. Its weight is tracked by the machine to calculate net fluid removal from the patient - an unexpectedly empty or overflowing bag is always worth investigating.

مزيج سائل الديلزة المستهلك والسائل المُرشَّح والراشح الفائق المُزال من المريض، يُجمع في كيس الراشح. يتتبع الجهاز وزنه لحساب صافي السائل المُزال من المريض - يستحق الكيس الفارغ بشكل غير متوقع أو الفائض الفحص دائماً.

label: Return line
خط العودة
description: Filtered/dialyzed blood travels back to the patient through the return (venous) lumen. An air detector and venous pressure sensor sit on this line as the last safety checks before blood re-enters the patient.
يعود الدم المُرشَّح/المُعالَج بالديلزة إلى المريض عبر تجويف العودة (الوريدي). يوجد كاشف هواء وحساس ضغط وريدي على هذا الخط كآخر فحوصات السلامة قبل عودة الدم إلى المريض.
alarms: Air detected in the return line

label: Pressure monitoring
مراقبة الضغوط
description: The device may display access, pre-filter, return and effluent pressure readings, plus calculated TMP and filter pressure drop (ΔP). TMP reflects pressure across the membrane; ΔP reflects the blood-path pressure drop through the filter. Use the machine-specific limits and trends with patient assessment; pressure changes alone cannot confirm clotting, catheter position or recirculation.

قد يعرض الجهاز ضغوط الوصول وما قبل المرشح والعودة وسائل الطرح، إضافةً إلى ضغط الغشاء المحسوب (TMP) وفرق ضغط المرشح (ΔP). يعكس TMP الضغط عبر الغشاء، بينما يعكس ΔP فرق الضغط على مسار الدم عبر المرشح. راجع اتجاهاتها وحدود الجهاز المحدد مع تقييم المريض؛ ولا تكفي تغيّرات الضغط وحدها لإثبات التخثر أو وضع القسطرة أو إعادة الدوران.

title: Access-pressure alarm after repositioning
إنذار ضغط الوصول بعد تغيير وضعية المريض
alarms.vignette: The machine alarms for high access pressure. The patient's femoral access line is at the groin, and the patient has just been repositioned.

question.prompt: What is the most appropriate first nursing action?
options: Assess the patient first, then check the access tubing for kinks, clamps or positional obstruction and follow the displayed device alarm guidance
Immediately increase the blood pump speed to clear the alarm
Disconnect and discard the circuit without further assessment
Silence the alarm and continue, since access pressure alarms are usually false
question.explanation: Check the patient and the actual device alarm first. Repositioning can cause a kink or positional catheter issue, but access-pressure signs and alarm terminology vary by machine. Trace the tubing and assess any obstruction under local CRRT procedures; never increase pump speed or bypass the alarm without authorization.

title: Rising TMP during CRRT
ارتفاع ضغط الغشاء (TMP) أثناء العلاج الكلوي المستمر
alarms.vignette: Over several hours, the transmembrane pressure has been trending upward and the filter looks darker than usual through the viewing window.

question.prompt: What does this trend most likely indicate, and what is the nursing priority?
options: Possible membrane clogging or filter clotting—review TMP and filter pressure-drop trends, assess the patient and treatment, and alert the trained CRRT team
A normal, expected finding that needs no action for the remainder of the prescribed run
Definite patient coagulopathy requiring immediate reversal of anticoagulation
A sign the replacement fluid rate is set too high and should be reduced immediately by the nurse
question.explanation: TMP is the pressure gradient across the filter membrane, whereas filter pressure drop (ΔP) measures resistance along the blood path. A slow isolated rise in TMP may suggest membrane clogging; a rise in ΔP may indicate blood-path clotting. A dark-looking filter alone is not diagnostic. Follow the relevant machine's pressure limits and alarm instructions; escalate rather than changing prescriptions independently.

title: Air-in-line alarm on the return line
إنذار وجود هواء في خط العودة
alarms.vignette: The air detector on the return line alarms and the machine has automatically clamped the return line.

question.prompt: What is the appropriate nursing response?
options: Assess the patient, keep the air-safety function active, and investigate the blood circuit with the trained team before any restart
Manually override the clamp immediately so therapy is not interrupted
Flush the return line with air to clear the sensor
Assume the sensor is faulty and continue without further checks
question.explanation: An air-in-return-line alarm can signal an air embolism hazard. Check the patient, never bypass the safety detector or override a clamped return line, and identify and correct the air source with trained staff under the device procedure before resuming treatment. Do not assume a specific bag or connection is responsible from the alarm alone.

title: Very negative access pressure with interrupted flow
ضغط وصول سالب جداً مع انقطاع التدفق
alarms.vignette: The access pressure alarm shows an unusually low (negative) reading and blood flow intermittently stops, especially when the patient moves.

question.prompt: What does this suggest, and what should the nurse do first?
options: Assess the patient and the displayed alarm, then check catheter and patient positioning, clamps and kinks according to the device protocol
The blood pump is set too slow and should be increased by the nurse without further assessment
This is always a sign of filter clotting and the filter should be changed
This is a normal variant that never needs reassessment
question.explanation: Very negative access pressure with movement-related blood-flow interruption can suggest a positional access problem, but actual alarm limits and pressure conventions depend on the device. Assess the patient first and check the tubing and catheter position using the local trained-team pathway; do not independently alter prescribed blood-flow settings.
